title: Beating on porch steps with chair rounds
summary: His first instrument was drums, played with chair rounds on neighbours' steps until they ran him off with buckets of water.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: What was the first instrument you started on? When did you start music? On drums. Beating on people's steps.
With chair rounds. And the people used to run me off, off they step and I would go on somebody else's step and tell them they run me off.
What would they do? How would they run you off?
Well, they would get a bucket of water and they'd come to the front door and they'd throw it on me.
Yeah, I heard somebody that did that there. It'd be terrible in the warm weather already. Yeah, yeah, in the warm weather. In the warm weather.
